rulingTitle: The report says AC-17's test also passed before the implementation, so the TDD evidence does not show this acceptance criterion's test failing without its implementation. The stated failing run only failed due to other ACs.

action.reason: AC-17 preserves existing behavior: an empty failed-jobs listing must cause no sibling success reads. Passing before implementation is expected for this regression criterion, not a defect.

rationale: The test asserts both an empty result and no recorded success-jobs calls. The fixture records calls even when they fail, so best-effort error handling cannot hide an unwanted sibling read. Production code explicitly skips sibling reads when jobs.length is zero. Removing that guard would produce a recorded pipeline-88 success read and violate the assertion. The spec requires this behavior, not a separately recorded mutation-test run.
